issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 §10 Types and Reflection; FHIR R4 model metadata for Reference and primitive uri
issues.evidence: Fresh native vs forced-fallback probes showed native fhirpath_text(Patient.managingOrganization.type().name) did not report Reference and native fhirpath_bool(Patient.managingOrganization.is(Reference)) returned false while the Python fallback returned true. Native type reflection also reported Questionnaire.url.type().name as string while fallback reported uri.
issues.root_cause: Native C++ type()/is() inference prioritized generic JSON/string handling and lacked FHIR datatype metadata for Reference objects and primitive uri choice fields.
issues.resolution: Native reflection now uses FHIR metadata before generic JSON fallback, normalizes value[x] choice suffixes to FHIRPath primitive names, detects Reference-like objects, and keeps TypeInfo JSON shape aligned with public Python fallback output.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 §10 type() reflection over collections
issues.evidence: Fresh parity probe showed native fhirpath_json({}, '(1|2).type()') returned a single TypeInfo item while the forced Python fallback returned two TypeInfo items.
issues.root_cause: The native C++ type() branch only reflected input[0] instead of mapping type reflection over every item in the input collection.
issues.resolution: Native type() now iterates all input items and emits one TypeInfo per input item with deterministic public JSON ordering.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 §10 Types and Reflection; FHIR R4 primitive type hierarchy for uri/code/string and Attachment.contentType
issues.evidence: Fresh probes showed DocumentReference.content.attachment.contentType.type().name was treated as string instead of code, and forced Python fallback rejected Questionnaire.url.is(string) despite uri being a string-compatible primitive subtype.
issues.root_cause: The Python model hierarchy did not include the uri -> string primitive parent edge and the shared R4 path metadata lacked a generic .contentType entry for media-type code reflection.
issues.resolution: Added generic .contentType -> code model metadata, Attachment shape inference, native code-field reflection for contentType, and a fallback model parent edge for uri -> string.
